content_of_post_to_comment:
I am spending around 10-12 hours on my phone just doomscrolling.
Idk i tried to delete social media from my phone but i always open them and i either stalk a guy or just scroll

I am being very unproductive with my studies or everyday life
Idk if i should deactivate all social media or what should i do
I am wasting my life
comment: Deleting apps can help, but it sounds like the habit is finding a new doorway every time. The stalking and scrolling might be filling a gap like boredom, stress, or avoiding difficult tasks. Try adding friction instead of relying on willpower: log out, use app limits, keep your phone away during study, and notice when you reach for it. The goal isn't to never use your phone, it's to stop it from deciding your day for you.
